column1: # Arch packages intentionally NOT ported to the Gentoo overlay, with reasons.
#   in-gentoo   the Gentoo monorepo already ships the package
#   arch-only   meaningful only inside an Arch/pacman system
#   blocked     port exists in principle but a hard blocker must clear first
#   wave3       planned, but beyond the current waves (needs real porting work)
# bin/gentoo-coverage (and the nightly coverage job) reads this file, so a
# package listed here never shows up as "unported" work.

column3: pacman keyring payload; meaningless under Portage
repackage of an Arch channel package (archive.archlinux.org payload)
ALPM post-install probes the host (CPU flags, CUDA soname) and rewrites /usr/bin/voxtype dispatch; needs a runtime-dispatch redesign over a 40-asset multi-variant layout
builds a networked nvim plugin tree at install time; needs an offline redesign
no Gentoo provider ships libcurl-gnutls.so.4; needs a dedicated compat package
hard-depends on gpu-screen-recorder, which ::gentoo does not package (GURU only); re-port when a provider lands

::gentoo ships dev-dotnet/dotnet-sdk-bin covering the six-way split payload (keywordless - needs package.accept_keywords); consumers should depend on virtual/dotnet-sdk, as the omarchy metapackage already does
